name: sendpaper
description: Print and mail real postcards and letters to US addresses via USPS First-Class. The agent drafts the mail and returns a print preview and a checkout link; nothing is mailed until you pay.

interface.longDescription: Send printed postcards (4x6, 6x9) and letters to any US address from Codex. Sendpaper returns an exact print preview and a Stripe checkout link; a person reviews every piece before it is printed and mailed via USPS First-Class.
defaultPrompt: Mail a thank-you postcard to someone who helped with this project
